revenueModel.text: KeyCorp earns revenue from individual, corporate, and institutional clients who pay for banking, lending, investment, and capital markets products and services, primarily in the United States.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive the majority of our revenues within the United States from customers domiciled in the United States.
